fields.name: title
fields.description: Page title. Used for the document title, navigation labels and social cards; falls back to the page's first H1 when omitted.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Short summary, used for the meta description, social cards and the blurb on link cards.

fields.name: slug
fields.description: Override the URL segment derived from the filename.

fields.name: draft
fields.description: Exclude the page from the built site and from navigation.

fields.name: redirect
fields.description: Redirect this URL elsewhere instead of rendering a page.

fields.name: order
fields.description: Sort position among sibling pages in generated navigation. Lower sorts first.

fields.name: date
fields.description: Publication date (ISO 8601). Used for ordering and display by blog-style listings.

fields.name: author
fields.description: Author name, used in article metadata and structured data.

fields.name: tags
fields.description: Free-form labels, filterable with the `field:value` grammar `collection` and `aggregate` share.

fields.name: image
fields.description: Page image, used for social cards and as the media for link cards.

fields.name: icon
fields.description: Icon name resolvable by the `icon` rune. `nav layout="cards"` renders it on each child page's card.

fields.name: tint
fields.description: Named tint preset for this page, or for the whole subtree when set in a `_layout.md`. Cascades down the layout chain; an explicit null resets to inherit from the layer above.

fields.name: tint-mode
fields.description: Initial colour-scheme behaviour. `auto` follows the user's preference; `light` / `dark` lock the server-rendered mode. Cascades down the layout chain.

fields.name: tint-lock
fields.description: Ignore the user's theme preference and hide the theme toggle — for surfaces that should look the same to every visitor. Cascades down the layout chain.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Register this page as an entity of the named type, so `collection`, `aggregate` and `xref` can find it. This is what drives the entity registry. A `routeRules` entry can set it for a whole subtree instead of per page.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Explicit entity ID for this page. Defaults to the page's slug.

fields.name: created
fields.description: Creation date (ISO 8601), overriding what git history or the filesystem reports.

fields.name: modified
fields.description: Last-modified date (ISO 8601), overriding what git history or the filesystem reports.
